title: A Washington judge grants a request to temporarily block Kalshi from offering sports-related bets in the state, citing a breach of the state gambling law (Timmy Shen/The Block)
summary: Timmy Shen / The Block: A Washington judge grants a request to temporarily block Kalshi from offering sports-related bets in the state, citing a breach of the state gambling law — Quick Take — A Washington court has granted the request to temporarily block Kalshi from offering sports-related event contracts in the state.
